# crit_val_sop {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
crit_val_sop(M, N, d1, d2; chart_choice, refinement=OrdinaryType(), alpha=0.05)
```
Compute the critical value for the asymptotic test based on spatial ordinal patterns (SOPs); see [`test_sop`](@ref).
 
  * `M::Int`: number of rows of the data matrix. The SOP matrix has `m = M - d1` rows.
  * `N::Int`: number of columns of the data matrix. The SOP matrix has `n = N - d2` columns.
  * `d1::Int`: row delay.
  * `d2::Int`: column delay.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`TauHat`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaHat`](@ref)`()`, [`TauTilde`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaTilde`](@ref)`()`, `Shannon()`, `ShannonExtropy()`, `DistanceToWhiteNoise()`.
  * `refinement`: [`OrdinaryType`](@ref)`()` for the classical SOP classification, or one of [`RotationType`](@ref)`()`, [`DirectionType`](@ref)`()`, [`DiagonalType`](@ref)`()` (only for the entropy-type charts).
  * `alpha=0.05`: significance level.

### Examples


```julia-repl
crit_val_sop(11, 11, 1, 1; chart_choice=TauHat())
```


:::
